messages.埋花櫼を得て自傷のタイムリミットを作り、致死の場面で加重値7の広域「汚血泣涙-終: A Gluttony Pierce E.G.O that gains Flower-burying Wedge to set a self-damage time limit, then slams in the 7-Attack-Weight Tears of the Tarnished Blood - The End [終] at the lethal moment.
messages.汚血泣涙-始: マッチ不可・敵に当たらないスキルで、使用後に埋花櫼を得る。最終威: **Tears of the Tarnished Blood - Inception [始]**: A skill that cannot Clash and does not hit enemies; after use, he gains Flower-burying Wedge. He takes fixed damage equal to its Final Power, but is not staggered and does not drop below 1 HP.
messages.埋花櫼と汚血: 埋花櫼はターン終了ごとに最大3まで増え、数値1につき攻撃レベル+: **Flower-burying Wedge and Tarnished Blood**: Flower-burying Wedge increases at each Turn End up to 3, with +2 Offense Level and −2 Defense Level per point. His leftmost basic attack gains Unbreakable Coins, and at 3 or more he gains Tarnished Blood (once per battle). Tarnished Blood removes 20% of max HP per point every turn.
messages.汚血泣涙-終: 体力が0になるダメージを受けると、体力1で踏みとどまり、そのター: **Tears of the Tarnished Blood - The End [終]**: When he takes damage that would bring his HP to 0, he holds on at 1 HP and it activates at the end of that turn. 7 Attack Weight and 4 Coins with no resource cost; the more Flower-burying Wedge and Tarnished Blood he has, the more damage it deals, and its Attack Weight and Base Power also rise with Tarnished Blood. He dies after use.
messages.破裂との連動: メインターゲットの破裂が5以上でコイン威力が上がり、的中時に破裂: **Rupture synergy**: Coin Power rises if the main target has at least 5 Rupture, and it inflicts Rupture Count and Rupture on hit.
messages.パッシブ「泣涙」: 攻撃で対象を倒すと次のターンにクイックと味方のダメージ量増加: **Passive — Crying Tears**: Defeating a target with an attack grants Haste and allies' Damage Up next turn, and Attack Power Down on enemies. The ally buffs and enemy debuffs still apply even if he dies.
messages.敵の破裂を溜めておき、覚醒の始で埋花櫼を得て、汚血が増えるまで待つ。体力が尽きる: Build up Rupture on enemies, gain Flower-burying Wedge with Inception on Awakening, and wait for Tarnished Blood to grow. Reach The End before his HP runs out.
messages.侵蝕スキルも埋花櫼を得る7枠の攻撃だが、敵味方識別不可で味方に当たり得る。: The Corrosion skill is also a 7-target attack that grants Flower-burying Wedge, but it cannot distinguish friend from foe and can hit allies.
messages.鴻園の君主を使えば、終での死亡が体力60%の回復に置き換わる。: With The Lord of Hongyuan, the death from The End is replaced by recovering 60% HP.
messages.Ⅲ: 終のダメージ量増加が強化され、破裂付与とコイン威力の条件も伸びる。侵蝕のコ: **Ⅲ**: Strengthens The End's damage increase and extends the Rupture infliction and Coin Power conditions. Corrosion's Coin Power and Rupture infliction are also strengthened.
messages.Ⅳ: 終のコイン威力が+5になり、汚血5以上で加重値・基本威力+3、破裂によるコ: **Ⅳ**: The End's Coin Power becomes +5, and +3 Attack Weight and Base Power at 5 or more Tarnished Blood and a cap of 3 on the Rupture-based Coin Power increase are added.
messages.鴻園の君主: パッシブで終の死亡が起きず体力60%を回復し、以降ダメージ量増加も: **[The Lord of Hongyuan](persona:0613)**: His passive prevents the death from The End and heals 60% HP, then grants Damage Up afterward. S2 (Gluttony) also supplies resources.
messages.K社3級摘出職職員: S2(暴食)が資源を出し、S2・S3で破裂を付与するので、: **[K Corp. Class 3 Excision Staff](persona:0605)**: S2 (Gluttony) supplies resources, and S2 and S3 inflict Rupture, making The End's Rupture condition easy to meet.
